meta.title: Mikhail Rusanov — fullstack developer
meta.description: A portfolio shaped like a desktop: an e-commerce platform in Go and Laravel, Nuxt websites, CRM systems. Projects start in Docker right in the browser.

lock.note: No password needed — it's just a greeting

note.label: Notes
note.title: Hi! I'm Mikhail, a fullstack developer.
note.body: Double-click a folder to see the projects. Each project first spins up in Docker, then opens in Safari.

docker.empty: Launch a project from Finder — its containers will show up here.
docker.compose: docker compose · {n} container | docker compose · {n} containers
docker.name: Name
docker.sandboxNote: This start is simulated: the code is commercial and private. Live demos that really start are in the Demos folder.
docker.busy: All sandboxes are busy — the next one frees up in about {minutes} min. Showing the project page for now.
docker.busyIp: Your address already runs the maximum number of sandboxes. Stop one to start another.
docker.failed: The stack didn't start. Showing the project page — please try again a bit later.
docker.live: Real containers: a separate stack for every visitor, with no internet access.

safari.start: Open a project from Finder or Docker.
